💥 SQL Server or Databricks? Choose wrong, and you could lose time, money, and momentum.
Data is exploding. Choosing the right engine isn’t just technical—it’s strategic. So I created a visual guide that breaks down the key differences between SQL Server and Databricks (Apache Spark)—so you can make the right call for your next project or interview. 🧠⚙️
📊 What’s inside: • OLTP vs. Big Data use cases
• Vertical vs. horizontal scaling
• Cost models: license vs. usage-based
• Real-world decision grid
• When to use both together (yes, that’s a thing!)
✅ Ideal for:
• Data Engineers & Architects
• Azure & Spark Practitioners
• Interview Prep Warriors
• Anyone migrating to modern data stacks
📥 Swipe the carousel or download the full PDF.
Let’s stop guessing and start architecting smarter.
